observations.summary: PPM sells setting up the customer's drawing standards once and then using them across subsequent as-built orders.
Skyline positions conversion of field markups to digital as-builts as a discrete drafting service and lists its outputs.
CADBRICKS lists native AutoCAD drawing types and invites architects to assess a one-floor trial where drafting is the bottleneck.
The company illustrates a historic opera house capture and BIM handoff and explains who can use the model. It is a broader capture benchmark.
Its Gray Space Architecture example identifies an actual 55-page legacy PDF-to-CAD conversion and the output format.
The indexed demo makes a production sequence visible from source point cloud to early 2D CAD. The format is useful even though Skarion's first offer starts with buyer-approved files.
observations.metrics_context: Count observed in the public search index. The platform measurement date was unavailable.

observations.summary: The industrial capture firm contrasts owner-maintained redlines with a targeted field scan of changed areas. Use it to frame which inputs are approved and which discrepancies the owner must verify.

payload.performance_read: A historical video had visible indexed counts. The LinkedIn and portfolio examples describe formats and calls to action. They lack comparable buyer response, impressions and timing for a performance ranking.

tests.idea: Test a four-panel before-and-after post. Hook: “Can your CAD lead trace every redline?” Show the approved markup, editable linework, revision register and one open reviewer item. Offer one sample DWG/PDF pair
tests.success_metric: qualified sample requests and small-batch scope calls

tests.idea: Test a founder post showing one client drafting standard in a synthetic sample. Use a legacy layer mapping and title-block example, then ask whether the buyer has an approved template for a one-batch pilot
tests.success_metric: responses with a sample standard, native format or batch size
